va-benefits-division.notes: VA Benefits Division — education, employment, home loans, pension, survivor benefits, burial. Set entry path or SQUAD_BAT_DIVISION_ENTRY_VA_BENEFITS_DIVISION env var.

business-opportunity-division.notes: Business & Opportunity Division — SDVOSB/VOSB certification, federal contracting, SBA programs, GSA surplus auctions, startup resources. Set entry path or SQUAD_BAT_DIVISION_ENTRY_BUSINESS_OPPORTUNITY_DIVISION env var.

medical-disability-division.notes: Medical & Disability Division entry path. Set to local clone of medical-disability-division repo entry point, or set SQUAD_BAT_DIVISION_ENTRY_MEDICAL_DISABILITY_DIVISION env var.

housing-division.notes: Housing Division entry path. Set to local clone of housing-division repo entry point, or set SQUAD_BAT_DIVISION_ENTRY_HOUSING_DIVISION env var.
